headline: The papercraft world gets its picnic finish
lede: TIDY BOT's reimagined skin collected its polish pass in one PR: the cloth reads picnic-cloth instead of keyboard, the title sign is a folded cut card, the cardboard bot shows its corrugation, the stove gains brass dials, and jam/place/break now throw tilted paper confetti — with crinkle and thud sounds to match the material.

notes.text: #3086 shipped end-to-end (#3090): all six polish items in the reimagined painter only — classic's pixels untouched, its golden f947d5dc unchanged, and both skins still pass the same spatial pixel laws.

Papercraft golden re-frozen at 17152d53 (the issue authorizes approved restyles) and proven to bite: a gingham-color mutation turns it red BY NAME while classic stays green. Sub-cell shape changes are deliberately invisible at the 40×30 signature — the raster-drift policy, now written into the README.

The 90-minute liveness window reaped a dead claim: mini died at claim time on #3086 with zero checkpoints, and slot a — after an honest REFUSED and a productive fill-the-window build — claimed exactly at expiry. First win in the #3053 family after ten correct refusals.
Filed #3088 (tidycheck's real-SPACE block swallows keys; reproduced on unmodified main) and the QA lane fixed it within the session via #3091 — filed-to-fixed inside an hour.
